conditions: Current programme-specific and general Faculty of Arts OER together govern the English IBC specialisation within BA Communication and Information Studies (56826), fulltime, 180 EC. Cohort starting 2026: 60 EC B1 +30 EC B2 core +30 EC two fixed Faculty of Arts minors +10 EC B3 PPD +5 EC Cross-cultural Language Use English +5 EC Academic and Professional Language Skills English +30 EC broadening bachelor electives +10 EC thesis. Free space cannot contain own-programme/other-specialisation courses; foreign study requires approval six working weeks before departure. Language courses must stay in one language. Spanish is a separate optional route, not an added English requirement. Zero-EC B1/B2 mentorship/portfolio and compulsory RADAr participation are not extra credits; workshops recommended. Attendance applies to mentorship and seminars; over35%absence in a period excludes participation subject to examiner exception. Practical assignments may condition exams. BSA45EC. Thesis starts only in semester2ofB3 under programme Article10 and current course foreknowledge, despite generic course text mentioning two intake dates; pre-register theme and Osiris. Online cross-cultural and English language-use courses presume basic statistics/SPSS. Course204 has misplaced Spanish foreknowledge text; not applied to English route. Prospective pages indicate2027–30 and differ in B3: do not replace current required English language skills with future Misinformation/Persuasion or Advanced Intercultural Communication. PDF visible2026–27 and June25metadata agree; no material hidden edition conflict.
